summary: Module 4 FIX: the canonical fix (replace regex with URL parser + reject absurdly long input) is already the fork's design -- validation uses urllib.parse.urlparse (no regex on the URL path, so no catastrophic backtracking surface), and I added defense-in-depth: CreateLinkRequest.long_url now capped at Field(max_length=2048), so oversized input is rejected before any processing. Combined option 1 + option 3 exactly as the module prescribes. Verified: live POST with the malicious 100k repeating-char URL returns within milliseconds (validation error string_too_long, HTTP 422), CPU stays normal; 2048-char URL still accepted; full suite 74 tests exit 0; server healthy.
